claims.text: Social/emotional: moves away from you, but looks to make sure you are close by; points to show you something interesting; puts hands out for you to wash them; looks @ a few pages in a book w you; helps you dress him by pushing arm thru sleeve or lifting up foot.

claims.text: Language/communication: tries to say ≥3 words besides mama or dada; follows 1-step directions w.o any gestures, like giving you the toy when you say, “Give it to me.”
